newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee prices higher, Brazils off on week.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee prices higher, Brazils off on week.

text.p: Most May/June arabica import prices in the Bremen fob market rose this week in line with futures, but Brazilian shippers cut their differentials, traders said on Friday.
They said roasters were unwilling to follow the market higher as they believed the fund buying action which was partly responsible for new futures highs might eventually be reversed.
But some May/June and Aug/Nov shipment Brazils were placed, Hamburg traders reported.
Robustas rose less strongly and were last lower, which resulted in Vietnamese, Indonesian and Cameroonian business.
